messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Seeking feedback on ggplot2 GUI
parts:
Hi everyone,

As you may (or may not) be aware, I am extending Deducer  (www.deducer.org) to cover the plotting system ggplot2. While the GUI is by no means finished, all of ggplot2's functionality has been implemented. I'd be interested to hear any thoughts from people who download and try it. Here is a screencast of the GUI in action:

http://neolab.stat.ucla.edu/cranstats/vlog3.mov

and the development version of Deducer can be downloaded with:

install.packages("Deducer",,"http://www.rforge.net",type="source")

If you don't already have Deducer working on your machine, follow the instructions:

http://www.deducer.org/pmwiki/index.php?n=Main.DownloadingAndInstallingDeducer



Best,
Ian

messages.subject: Re: Seeking feedback on ggplot2 GUI

Truly amazing work!

After watching your introductory video, I feel that a project such as
this will help those of us who are unsure of all of the options
available for a given task. Being able to experiment with each option
will be invaluable.

I'll definitely start to use this for some of my more routine analysis
needs.
